Title: EPIC: Platform Foundation (Identity
Body: Consent
column4: Goal: Build shared rails for PunjabNext. Includes farmer/provider onboarding, consent, audit, and payments rails.

Title: Story: Farmer onboarding (Aadhaar/phone) UX
Body: As a farmer, I can onboard with phone OTP + optional Aadhaar eKYC, select language (Punjabi/Hindi), and create my profile. Acceptance: OTP verified, profile created, language saved.

Title: Story: Provider onboarding (CHC/tractor owner/operator)
Body: As a provider, I can register business type (CHC/Owner/Operator), service area, equipment list, and payout method. Acceptance: provider profile + equipment created.

Title: Story: Role-based access control (RBAC)
Body: Implement roles: Farmer, Provider, Buyer, BankAgent, GovtAdmin. Acceptance: API + UI permissions enforced.

Title: Story: Consent & data sharing module
Body: Farmer can grant/revoke consent to share data with bank/insurer/buyer. Acceptance: consent ledger + audit trail.

Title: Story: UPI payment integration (basic)
Body: Support UPI intent/QR payment for bookings and receipts. Acceptance: payment success/failure stored + downloadable receipt.

Title: Story: Wallet ledger (transactions + receipts)
Body: Maintain immutable transaction ledger for farmer/provider. Acceptance: every payment creates ledger entry + receipt ID.

Title: Story: Notifications (SMS/WhatsApp hooks placeholder)
Body: Send booking/payment/status updates via SMS/WhatsApp integration placeholders. Acceptance: notification events logged.

Title: EPIC: Mechanization Marketplace (CHC + Pay-per-Use)
Body: Goal: Machinery-as-a-Service to reduce ownership debt. Booking, dispatch, proof-of-service, settlement.

Title: Story: Equipment catalog + pricing
Body: Provider can list equipment/implements, rates (per hour/per acre), availability. Acceptance: searchable catalog.

Title: Story: Search CHC/providers by village/tehsil
Body: Farmer searches by location + service type and sees ranked providers. Acceptance: results with distance + ETA.

Title: Story: Booking flow (schedule + job details)
Body: Farmer requests service (type, acres, date/time, location). Acceptance: booking created with status.

Title: Story: Dispatch & acceptance by provider
Body: Provider can accept/decline bookings, assign operator, update ETA. Acceptance: status transitions tracked.

Title: Story: Proof-of-service (GPS + photo + timestamps)
Body: Capture start/stop, geo-tag, photos, operator signature. Acceptance: proof attached, tamper-evident hash stored.

Title: Story: Settlement release to provider
Body: After proof verified, release payment to provider and generate invoice/receipt. Acceptance: settlement completed.

Title: Story: Dispute workflow (farmer/provider)
Body: Allow disputes within N hours; hold settlement if disputed. Acceptance: dispute ticket + resolution status.

Title: EPIC: Credit Enablement (Usage-based
Body: KCC-aligned)
Labels: Goal: Make credit healthier by linking to verified activity and input spend. Not replacing banks—connecting rails.

Title: Story: Farm activity timeline (bookings + crop cycle)
Body: Create farmer activity timeline from mechanization usage and self-reported crop stage. Acceptance: timeline visible.

Title: Story: Input spend tracking (optional upload/scan)
Body: Farmer logs input purchases (manual or receipt upload). Acceptance: categorized spend per acre.

Title: Story: Credit readiness score v1 (rules-based)
Body: Score using activity trail, punctual payments, seasonality. Acceptance: score generated + explainable factors.

Title: Story: Bank/agent portal (lead intake)
Body: Bank agent views leads, verifies docs, marks stage. Acceptance: pipeline stages + notes.

Title: Story: Restricted credit wallet rules (inputs-only) concept
Body: Define policy for restricting spend categories. Acceptance: rules engine stub + tags.

Title: Story: Insurance trigger model placeholder
Body: Define satellite/weather trigger data model and payout workflow stub. Acceptance: event-driven payout mock.

Title: EPIC: Market Linkage (Price
Body: Buyers
column4: Goal: Improve returns by reducing distress sales and expanding buyer access with price intelligence.

Title: Story: Mandi price feed ingestion (manual + API-ready)
Body: Ingest daily mandi prices (CSV/manual first, API later). Acceptance: district crop price charts.

Title: Story: Price alerts + best-sell window nudges
Body: Farmer sets crop + target price; system alerts. Acceptance: alerts sent + logged.

Title: Story: Create listing (crop lot + quality attributes)
Body: Farmer posts listing with quantity, moisture, grade, photos. Acceptance: listing searchable.

Title: Story: Buyer bidding & offer acceptance
Body: Buyers submit bids; farmer accepts; generates order. Acceptance: order created + status tracked.

Title: Story: Logistics quote & scheduling placeholder
Body: Integrate logistics as module stub (manual partner first). Acceptance: pickup scheduled + status updates.

Title: Story: Escrow settlement for trade
Body: Hold buyer funds; release on delivery confirmation. Acceptance: escrow ledger entries + release rules.

Title: EPIC: Data & KPI Dashboard (Punjab outcomes)
Body: Goal: Track success metrics: cost/acre reduction, rental adoption, distress sales reduction, payment speed.

Title: Story: KPI definitions + calculation service
Body: Implement KPI engine: rental usage %, cost/acre, time-to-payment, distress sale proxy. Acceptance: API outputs.

Title: Story: Farmer dashboard (simple
Body: voice-friendly)
Labels: Show: cost/acre, bookings, payments, price alerts. Acceptance: usable in low literacy context.

Title: Story: Govt dashboard (district heatmaps) v1
Body: District metrics for adoption, service volume, payment speed. Acceptance: filters by tehsil/district.

Title: Story: Audit logs + transparency reports
Body: Generate reports for subsidies/settlements/disputes. Acceptance: exportable CSV + role-limited.

Title: EPIC: Security & Compliance (India-ready)
Body: Goal: Build trust: privacy, audit, secure storage, DPDP-aligned practices.

Title: Story: Data classification + retention policy
Body: Define data classes and retention windows. Acceptance: documented + enforced in code config.

Title: Story: Secure storage for proofs (S3-like) + encryption
Body: Store proof-of-service photos securely with encryption at rest. Acceptance: signed URLs + access control.

Title: Story: Threat model + abuse prevention
Body: Prevent fake proofs, location spoofing signals, rate-limit endpoints. Acceptance: controls + monitoring.

Title: EPIC: Pilot Operations (Punjab rollout playbook)
Body: Goal: Run a district pilot with CHCs, banks, and selected crops (wheat/paddy).

Title: Story: District pilot selection + onboarding checklist
Body: Create checklist: CHC onboarding, bank partner, mandi price source, helpline. Acceptance: pilot kit in docs.

Title: Story: Training modules (farmer/provider) in Punjabi
Body: Scripts + screenshots + short videos outline. Acceptance: training content ready.

Title: Story: Field support ticketing (helpline)
Body: Basic ticket system for pilot. Acceptance: tickets created, routed, resolved.
